target: exact all-output N=11 Fourier on the original v33 99-edge support
theorem_scope: weights integral at the cyclotomic prime (1-zeta_11), no poles
main_necessary_condition: at least 7 of 99 weights have zero residue modulo (1-zeta_11)
model_boundary: does not rule out arbitrary complex, pi-polar, or gauge-transformed weight solutions
